howToApply: Visit IREL official website: www.irel.co.in and navigate to the recruitment portal.
Click on ‘Click here’ to register for Online Application of IREL (India) Limited.
Step-I: Fill in Personal Details and Contact Details, then click ‘Generate OTP’. Enter OTPs received on Mobile and Email to verify.
Agree to terms & conditions, re-verify details, and click ‘Submit’ to complete registration. Note down the Application Sequence Number (User ID) and Password received on registered email/mobile.
Step-II: Re-login and complete Personal Details, Additional Details, Communication Details, Qualification Details, Declaration, and upload relevant documents including photograph and signature.

Upload scanned passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, min 100KB max 200KB, 3.5cm x 4.5cm, white background, not older than 3 months) and signature (JPG/JPEG, min 80KB max 150KB, black ink on white paper).
Preview the application form and verify all details. Edit if required before final submission.
Submit the application and pay the applicable application fee online via Payment Gateway (Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking/Wallets/UPI).
Print and retain the submitted Application Form and Payment Acknowledgement Slip for future reference.
Internal candidates must forward printout of online application form to Recruitment Section, Corporate Office, Mumbai through proper channel.

Save the PDF of the submitted online application form for future reference. Do not send the printout to MRPL unless specifically asked.
